pages.title: Third Eye
pages.text: The ability to see beyond the physical world is referred to as $(#ad03fc)Third Eye$().$(br)Humans do not possess such an ability to see $(#ad03fc)beyond the veil$(),$(br)however with certain substances and contraptions the knowledgeable summoner can work $()

The most comfortable, and most *expensive*, way to obtain this ability, is to wear spectacles$(br)infused with spirits, that *lend* their sight to the wearer.$(br)A slightly more nauseating, but $(bold)very affordable$() alternative is the $()
consumption of certain herbs,$(br)$(l:getting_started/demons_dream)Demon's Dream$(/l) most prominent among them.$(br)

$(l:crafting_rituals/craft_otherworld_goggles)These goggles$(/l) allow to see even more hidden Otherworld blocks,$(br)however they do not allow harvesting those materials.$(br)Low-tier materials can be harvested by consuming $(l:getting_started/demons_dream)Demon's Dream$(/l),$(br)but more valuable materials require special tools.$()
